notes: Physical I/O (Input connectors: XLR, Jack; Output connectors: XLR) confirmed on the official RCF datasheet (Rev. M, 23/02/2024, rcf.it). The datasheet itself does not name the power-inlet connector type explicitly (it only states "Connections: VDE" plus SMPS/CE compliance); the IEC-style inlet with fuse holder and rocker power switch was corroborated via secondary retailer/manual sources and is consistent with the rest of the RCF ART MK4/MK5 line, hence medium overall confidence (high confidence on the audio I/O, lower on the exact power-inlet connector). No bandwidth-graded connectors are present (pure analog audio plus AC power), so no "grade" field applies to any port. Not rack-mountable — portable pole-mount cabinet with M10 fly points, 35 mm pole socket, and top+side carry handles; rackUnits omitted. Sold as two non-interchangeable AC-voltage SKUs (100-120V and 220-240V); connector layout is identical between them.

ports.name: Input (XLR)
ports.note: Combo mic/line input, balanced/unbalanced; XLR with parallel 1/4" jack; Mic sensitivity -32 dBu, Line sensitivity -2/+4 dBu, selectable via rear MIC/LINE switch

ports.name: Output (XLR Link)
ports.note: Balanced link output for daisy-chaining to additional powered speakers

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Mains power inlet; VDE-compliant with fuse holder and power switch; sold in two non-interchangeable factory voltage variants (100-120V PN 13000855, 220-240V PN 13000824)
